name: comp-128
title: Navigation Card Button
blurb: Card-styled button with heading, description, and right chevron that translates…
description: An outline button formatted as a card with heading, subtitle text, and animated chevron icon. Icon translates right on hover.
use_when: Creating navigation cards for different sections or destinations in a menu.
avoid_when: When content is very short or when card layout is not needed.
a11y: Icon is aria-hidden. Text content describes the destination.
